identity.title: Persist release-candidate stage results on failure

origin.summary: The remaining-work reconciliation identified a safe 2D-047 gap: the release-candidate gate writes a summary only after all stages pass, so a failed run loses stage-level evidence.

state.current_summary: 2D-047 is resolved for the existing release-gate owner: VerifyReleaseCandidate.ps1 now records a single failure summary with stage-level PASS/FAIL/NotRun/Skipped states and failure context while retaining the original nonzero exit. Prior success-path evidence remains authoritative; a new clean-checkout RC run is still PL-0061's separate blocked boundary.

objective.summary: Make VerifyReleaseCandidate.ps1 persist a single release_candidate_summary.json for both successful and failed runs, with explicit PASS/FAIL/NotRun/Skipped stage statuses while preserving the original nonzero failure exit.
constraints: Reuse tools/VerifyReleaseCandidate.ps1 as the sole owner; do not add a parallel gate or wrapper.
Do not relax the clean tracked-tree, clean distribution, build, or launch gates.
Do not perform release publication, tag, deployment, commit, or push.
Keep any runtime/release evidence under the repository's existing release-artifact contract; no claim of a clean checkout is made by this local change.

criteria.text: The gate records stage statuses and a failure stage/message in release_candidate_summary.json when a preflight or execution stage fails; stages not reached remain NotRun and explicitly skipped stages remain Skipped.
A failed gate still exits nonzero, while the existing successful summary fields and success exit behavior remain available on a fully passing run.
The owner, call path, duplicate-prevention decision, focused checks, and remaining clean-checkout/release boundary are recorded in durable project documents.

context.summary: Existing release-candidate orchestration owner and stage call path.

evidence.observation: The actual VerifyReleaseCandidate.ps1 dirty-tree failure exited 1 and still wrote release_candidate_summary.json with Status=FAIL, FailureStage=Preflight, the clean-tree error, NotRun downstream stages, and explicit Skipped stages.

PowerShell parser and focused source-contract checks passed with zero syntax errors and confirmed the finally block, stage ledger, FailureStage/FailureMessage, NotRun/Skipped states, and preserved throw path.

The existing success-path release gate completed with ReleaseCandidateVerification=PASS and recorded the original summary fields; this prior evidence is retained rather than rerunning a clean gate from the current dirty checkout.

events.summary: Closed the 2D-047 failure-evidence gap in the existing VerifyReleaseCandidate.ps1 owner; no parallel runner or release policy was added.
